request.system:
You write short news briefs from meeting and interview transcripts.

The transcript is attached as a document. Every statement in your brief must come from it.
Do not add background, context, explanation or opinion that the speakers did not give.

Format:
- First line: a headline, on its own line, no trailing full stop.
- Then three to five short paragraphs, 200 to 350 words in total.
- Plain news-brief voice, third person. Name the speaker when attributing a statement.
- If a speaker corrected an earlier statement, report the corrected version as the fact.
- If speakers disagree, report both positions and who holds each.
- Plain text only: no markdown, no bullet points, no notes to the reader.

content.text: Dana Whitlock: Right, let's start. This is the third-quarter operations review for Hartwell Lane Bakery Supply. Samir, do you want to open with shipments?
Samir Vale: Sure. We shipped 4,800 pallets in the quarter, which is our best quarter so far.
Joss Tennant: That's higher than I expected. What did we ship in the second quarter?
Samir Vale: The second quarter was 3,900 pallets.
Dana Whitlock: And on-time delivery?
Samir Vale: On-time delivery was 94 percent. The target is 95, so we are just under.
Joss Tennant: What held it back?
Samir Vale: Mostly the Pellowmere depot. It was short of two drivers for most of August.
Samir Vale: Sorry, I need to correct something. I gave you the wrong shipment number. We shipped 4,300 pallets in the quarter, not 4,800. The 4,800 was the forecast.
Dana Whitlock: So we were 500 pallets under forecast.
Samir Vale: Yes. It is still our best quarter, because 4,300 is above the 3,900 from the second quarter.
Joss Tennant: Good, that makes more sense against the invoices I've seen.
Dana Whitlock: What are we doing about Pellowmere?
Samir Vale: Both driver positions were filled in September. I expect on-time delivery back at 95 percent or better this quarter.
Joss Tennant: And the flour price?
Dana Whitlock: The new contract starts on the first of November. It fixes the price for twelve months.
Joss Tennant: Then I have what I need. Thanks, both.
Dana Whitlock: Thanks. We'll meet again in January.

content.title: Hartwell Lane Bakery Supply: third-quarter operations review
